record.question: Which one of the following is the feature of 74th Amendment Act on Municipalities?
options: The procedure for maintenance of accounts and audit would be decided by the State Governor
Reservation of seats for SCs and STs in proportion of their population (to the total population) in Municipal Area
Constitution of Nagar Panchayats for smaller urban area
One – third of the seats shall be reserved for women, excluding the number of seats reserved for SC and ST women
